name: dxd-skills
description: Reusable skills for coding agents across software engineering, interface design, writing, research, and project workflows.

interface.longDescription:
DXD Skills is a collection of reusable workflows for developers, designers, and teams working with coding agents. Its main purpose is to improve software development and the design, writing, research, and project work that supports it.

Engineering skills review code structure, send a diff to a different model family for an adversarial bug review, investigate bugs and architecture with Open PStack, set up CI verification, simplify test suites, derive HTTP clients or CLIs from browser traffic, and sync deployment branches.

Design and writing skills create and edit designs in Paper, improve UI text, and write Simplified Technical English when asked. Company research skills produce reusable profiles, bios, and page copy.

Project and agent workflows learn from recent agent sessions to improve reusable skills and adapt communication for readers with ADHD.

The plugin provides skill instructions and supporting files. Workflows use your agent's workspace and enabled tools; the package does not include a hosted service or MCP server.
